axis_a_decision.purpose: test WIDEN / HOLD / SHRINK action correctness only; NO adaptive-value claim based on Axis A (task Sec. 3/10/11/15/23)

eligibility.WIDEN_SHRINK: frozen label WIDEN/SHRINK (embeds statistical support >= 2x paired SE AND direction margin Delta_dir >= 0.05) AND frozen-reference action is the realized-best action in >= 0.80 of the 8 headline replicates
eligibility.HOLD: frozen label HOLD (reference indifference: |widen_over_base| <= 0.03 AND |shrink_over_base| <= 0.03) AND >= 0.80 of the 8 headline replicates place BOTH perturbation arms within +-5% of BASE

selection_rule: 2. maximize config coverage: >= 4 distinct event configs per class AND <= 2 states per (config, class)
3. within equal coverage prefer larger headline-budget stability
axis_a_decision.algorithm_deterministic: per class: process configs in (config_id) ascending; within each config take eligible candidates sorted by (stability_desc, margin_desc, s2_asc) up to 2; accumulate across configs until 8; if short, fill from remaining eligible candidates by the same sort. Verbatim replay of the BV-v0 locked selection algorithm; expected result equals the recorded BV-v0 8/8/8 selection (cross-checked deterministically). Selection uses ONLY reference label / margin / stability / legality / config coverage -- no controller performance.

axis_b_value.algorithm_deterministic: per class: process configs in (config_id) ascending; within each config take eligible candidates sorted by (stability_desc, margin_desc, s2_asc) up to 3; accumulate across configs until 12; if short, fill from remaining eligible candidates by the same sort. axis_b_value.no_hold_without_amendment: no HOLD states unless a future amendment defines a distinct measurable-value HOLD concept BEFORE any controller run

unified_functional.definition: J(pi) = median_state [ median_replicate log( M2(pi, state) / M2(BASE, state) ) ] over the 24 selected Axis-B states
unified_functional.per_replicate: replicate-level paired log-ratio of the acted arm's M2 over that replicate's BASE-arm M2 (CRN-matched within replicate)
unified_functional.median_order: median over the 8 replicates per state, then median over the 24 states
unified_functional.oracle_per_state: frozen reference action arm of that state
unified_functional.best_fixed_definition: BestFixed = argmin over f in {ALWAYS_WIDEN, ALWAYS_SHRINK, ALWAYS_HOLD} of J(f); J(ALWAYS_HOLD) = 0 by construction (log(M2(BASE)/M2(BASE)) per replicate)
unified_functional.no_dual_aggregation: BestFixed selection and Oracle headroom measurement use the SAME functional J; no other aggregation is used for either

value_gates.BV2-V0: 12 WIDEN + 12 SHRINK selected deterministically; all states legal; all states stable; all states satisfy the value-margin threshold; config coverage constraints pass; no controller outputs used
value_gates.BV2-V1: fixed-rule tradeoff report: J(ALWAYS_WIDEN), J(ALWAYS_SHRINK), J(ALWAYS_HOLD) + class-conditional performance; if one fixed rule is simultaneously near-optimal on both W and S classes, mark benchmark WEAK (diagnostic flag, not a hard gate)
value_gates.BV2-V2: Oracle feasibility via the unified functional in ONE mathematically equivalent form: G_Oracle >= -log(0.95) = 0.0512933 (equivalently exp(-G_Oracle) <= 0.95); strong target (report only): equivalent ratio <= 0.90
value_gates.BV2-V3: opposite-class regret: R_opp,W = median over W states of median-replicate M2(ALWAYS_SHRINK)/M2(ALWAYS_WIDEN) >= 1.05 AND R_opp,S = median over S states of median-replicate M2(ALWAYS_WIDEN)/M2(ALWAYS_SHRINK) >= 1.05; paired ratio computed per replicate, then median over the 8 replicates, then median over class states (same pairing semantics as the frozen BV-v0 Oracle ratio)
value_gates.if_v2_fails: VALUE benchmark = infeasible; STOP before controller evaluation; NO threshold relaxation (task Sec. 20/31)

firewall.no_controller_performance_in_selection: no use of controller performance during benchmark selection

negative_result_discipline: reintroduce HOLD to rescue the Oracle metric
amendment_rule: any amendment must be committed BEFORE additional characterization and must explicitly state observed outcomes; NO amendment after controller results exist (task Sec. 31)
